fork_receipt.scope: Local fork execution; funded test accounts and reward-root fixtures. No native World App acceptance or mainnet transaction submission.

tests.note: The 22 fork tests and six additional security tests are subsets of the 402-test final run. Characterization proof passes do not mean remediation.

coverage.limitations: Assembly source mapping and branch coverage remain limited; no separate stateful invariant campaign was performed.

triage_by_check.reason: Treasury and token/strategy sources are fixed; refill is restricted to bot/treasury, budgeted and balance-checked.
Payout recipients are immutable bot/keeper or treasury-only recovery; the caller cannot supply an arbitrary recipient.
Reviewed full-precision arithmetic, inert code storage/reconstruction and revert bubbling. Assembly coverage remains limited.
Prototype token lists are bounded at 32. Malformed owner-selected token views can prevent release; this is not an active production route.
Prototype allowlist mutation has the explicit 32-token cap.
Complex fee, income and fallback code merits further invariant work; complexity alone did not establish an exploit.
Full-precision mulDiv normalization/Newton iteration and fixed-point TickMath use intentional staged arithmetic.
Exact checks enforce fixed-token and strategy balance deltas, minimum outputs and custody invariants; fee-on-transfer tokens are outside configured routes.
XOR is the intentional modular-inverse seed from the documented full-precision multiplication algorithm.
Undeployed multi-token prototype cannot recover forced ETH, while its factory requires zero ETH for release.
ERC20 optional returns, authorized ETH payout and immutable creation-code assembly are deliberate; failed calls revert or use the documented fallback.
Recipients are checked through _validRecipient; deployer inputs are fixed by validated factories and revalidated in child constructors.
Identifier conventions do not establish a custody vulnerability.
Asset-moving entrypoints have nonReentrant guards and authorization; balance deltas are intentional postconditions on fixed assets. No actionable callback path was established.
Guarded asset operations and role/state validation prevent an actionable financial callback; event and view ordering alone is not an exploit.
Mutating financial paths and deployer creation are guarded; public read-only transient values do not grant a write or spending right in this repository.
Heartbeat, review and budget windows intentionally use chain timestamps; owner-renewal versus settlement ordering remains transaction-order dependent.
Documented fixed-point tick constants and precision factors are deliberate.
Solidity locals and memory structs in these paths have the intended zero defaults; no uninitialized storage pointer is involved.
Unused pool fields are deliberate; receipt withdrawal is constrained by prior share transfer and subsequent token/share balance checks.

static_analysis.note: Slither returns a nonzero findings status. Raw severities are not confirmed vulnerabilities; all diagnostic IDs are accounted for by check category.

live_readback.note: Read-only normalized comparisons exclude compiler CBOR metadata and compiler-declared runtime immutable offsets. Constructor configuration read separately. No transactions.

compiler_registry.assessment: No concrete compiler exploit demonstrated. Relevant memory-delete, recursion and wraparound source patterns were not identified. SOL-2026-7 generated-code applicability was not fully excluded.
